user.title: Pool Pump Manager
user.description: Pick the pump switch, the temperature mode, and the temperature source. Use 'Water sensor' if you have a probe; otherwise 'Air-based model' integrates a thermal model from an air temperature input.

data.temperature_sensor: Temperature sensor (water probe or air temp)

options.title: Pool, scheduling and electrolyzer
options.description: Pick the pool model (drives the dashboard visual and, in air-based mode, the default thermal time constant). Duration is computed as temperature / 2 (or /3 below 13 °C), clamped between min and max hours, centered on the pivot hour. A forecast sensor above the heatwave threshold forces max hours.

data.pool_has_cover: Pool has a cover (slower thermal response)
data.tau_hours: Thermal time constant τ (hours, blank = derive from pool model)
data.pivot_hour: Pivot hour (run centered around this hour, local time)
data.heatwave_threshold: Heatwave threshold (°C) — at or above, run max hours
data.electrolyzer_post_start_delay: Electrolyzer ON delay after pump start (s)
data.electrolyzer_pre_stop_delay: Electrolyzer OFF lead time before pump stop (s)
data.electrolyzer_min_temp: Electrolyzer min water temp (°C; cell off below)
data.electrolyzer_max_temp: Electrolyzer max water temp (°C; cell off above)
data.water_level_critical: Low-water binary sensor (optional; pump stays off when on)
data.solar_installed_watts: Installed solar capacity (W, recommended — stable peak reference)
data.solar_peak_sensor: Today's peak solar power sensor (W, fallback if installed capacity is not set)
data.solar_coefficient: Solar coupling coefficient (°C/h at full sun, default 0.6)
data.autotune_enabled: Self-tune water temperature offset from manual calibrations
data.custom_pool_shape: Custom pool: shape (used only when preset = Custom)
data.custom_pool_width: Custom pool: width (cm, ignored for round)
data.custom_pool_inground: Custom pool: in-ground (vs above-ground frame pool)
data.earliest_start_hour: Earliest hour the pump can run (0-24, 0 = no limit)
data.latest_end_hour: Latest hour the pump can run (0-24, 24 = no limit)
data.show_illustration: Show pool illustration on the card

abort.already_configured: This pool pump is already configured.
